text: You, based on your past reviews, tend to like recipes featuring soy-tofu, beans, fresh mushrooms, and bisques-cream-soups [F4]. However, Linda's Chunky Garlic Mashed Potatoes doesn't fit this pattern exactly, as it features potatoes and garlic instead [F4]. On the other hand, it does include sour cream, which is something you've liked in the past [F13]. This recipe is also in line with your usual preference for lower sugar content [F5].
